A single example of this species was obtained in Norfolk, in October, 1896.

The Dartford Warbler was identified at Wells, Norfolk, on December 15th, 1905; two pairs nested near Ludlow, Shropshire, in 1903; and it is believed to have nested near Cannock Chase, Staffordshire, about 1870.

*Subfamily—SYLVIINÆ.*

*Sylvia melanocephala, GMEL.*
